title: 4.8 Did you clean the kitchen?
unit_title: Life at home, every day and yesterday
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, talk about the lights and machines, ask what there is, describe someone's morning in order, say what you did yesterday and on which day, ask and tell the time, say how often you do things and give dates.
goal: Ask about the past with Did you…? / Did she…? and answer Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. (Did you cook breakfast? Yes, I did.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 4.8 Do you…? Questions and replies: A1 asks Do you…? about habits; A1+ 4.8 asks about the past with Did, the past form of do (Did you clean the kitchen? Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.), and Did she…? after A1+ 1.9's Does she…?. After did the verb is the base form, so A1 4.8's own study and work come back as they are (Did you study yesterday? / Did you work yesterday?), under the user's 2026-11-13 decision. A1 4.8's photos of Ana and Luis at a café show Ana's answer with a thumb up or down; photos of Ana cooking, studying and at her desk show what she did; A1 4.7's photos show the mother and the boy. Listen sets Did against Do and Does, and short-answer banks set did against do.
prerequisite: A1 4.8 Do you…? Yes, I do. No, I do not.; A1+ 1.9 Does she…?; A1+ 4.7 the past with -ed.
speaking_outcome: Say did with a short i (DID) and didn't as one beat (DID-nt). Do not require native-like speed.
